description.description: Description of the query. Max size = 256.
The description of the URL category. Maximum length of 256 characters.

id.description: The unique system identifier for this specific URL Category resource.

name.description: A unique, user-friendly name for the URL Category. Required field. Name must be less than 56 characters

tags.description: An array (list) of key-value tags or labels for organizational purposes. Allows a maximum of 10 unique tags.

threat_content_version.description: The version of the threat intelligence database that provides this URL category definition. Applies primarily to system categories.

url_category_index.description: An internal index number used by the system to identify the URL category.

url_category_type.description: Specifies whether the category is system-defined or user-created.
